column1: # Local phrase supplement: high-frequency words missing from the pinned
# Same TSV shape as lexicon.tsv: reading(s, hyphen-separated)\ttext\tscore.
# Scores are negative log-ish like upstream: calibrate against sibling words
# (選擇 -8.78, 候選 -10.24, 賄選 -11.60) so newcomers compete honestly instead
# of steamrolling. Comment lines and blank lines are ignored by the parser.
# Policy: add only words a user demonstrably hit (debug trace / fixture);
# never bulk-import. Learned picks (UserLexicon) remain the per-user layer.
